voyage.definition:
n. a journey to some distant place
v. travel on water propelled by wind or by other means
voyage.translation:
n. 航行, 航海, 航程, 旅行, 航空
vi. 航海, 航行
vt. 航行越过, 飞过

voyage charter party.translation: [法] 航程租赁契约, 航次租赁契约

voyage clause.translation: [法] 航程条款, 航次条款

voyageable.definition: a. That may be sailed over, as water or air; navigable.
voyageable.translation: a. 能航行的, 能航海的

voyaged.translation: v. 航行, 远行, （尤指）远航( voyage的过去式和过去分词 )

voyager.definition: n. a traveler to a distant land (especially one who travels by sea)
voyager.translation: n. 航行者, 航海者

voyagers.definition: n. a traveler to a distant land (especially one who travels by sea)
voyagers.translation: n. 空中黑客（BBC纪录片《昆虫帝国》第四集）

voyages.definition:
n an act of traveling by water
n a journey to some distant place
v travel on water propelled by wind or by other means
voyages.translation:
n. 航行, 航海, 航天( voyage的名词复数 )
v. 航行, 远行, （尤指）远航( voyage的第三人称单数 )

voyageur.definition:
n. A traveler; -- applied in Canada to a man employed by the
   fur companies in transporting goods by the rivers and across the land,
   to and from the remote stations in the Northwest.
voyageur.translation: n. 加拿大的船夫或樵夫, 旅客

voyageurs.translation: 加拿大的船夫或樵夫, 旅客( voyageur的名词复数 )

voyageurs national park.translation: [网络] 樵夫国家公园；探险家国家公园；加拿大船工

voyaging.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Voyage
voyaging.translation: v. 航行, 远行, （尤指）远航( voyage的现在分词 )

voyeur.definition: n. a viewer who enjoys seeing the sex acts or sex organs of others
voyeur.translation: n. 偷看下流场面的人

voyeurism.definition: n. a perversion in which a person receives sexual gratification from seeing the genitalia of others or witnessing others' sexual behavior

voyeurist.translation: n. 窥淫癖者, 窥阴部色情者

voyeuristic.definition: a. of or relating to voyeurs or voyeurism

voyeurs.definition: n. a viewer who enjoys seeing the sex acts or sex organs of others
voyeurs.translation: n. <贬>窥淫癖者（喜欢窥视他人性行为）( voyeur的复数形式 ); 刺探隐秘者（喜欢刺探他人的问题或私生活）

voyvodina.translation: 伏伊伏丁那[南斯拉夫自治省名]
